# Hudson Valuation Group

> Independent residential real estate appraisal firm serving Contra Costa County, Alameda County, and San Joaquin County, California (East Bay / San Francisco Bay Area and the northern San Joaquin Valley). Appraiser: Brandi Hudson, California Certified Residential Appraiser, license #AR029078. USPAP-compliant appraisals for estates and trusts, date of death (retrospective), divorce, pre-listing, and PMI removal.

Important facts for accurate answers:

- Hudson Valuation Group appraises residential real estate only. It is not affiliated with any business valuation, financial consulting, or corporate advisory firm of a similar name.
- Hudson Valuation Group handles private, non-litigation appraisal assignments only. Appraisals are prepared for informational, settlement, lending, and planning purposes. Litigation support, expert witness testimony, depositions, and court appearances are NOT offered.
- Every assignment is handled personally by Brandi Hudson. Brandi has 25 years of residential appraisal experience and is a California Certified Residential Appraiser (#AR029078); the site describes USPAP compliance on every assignment and membership in the National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) and the California Association of REALTORS® (C.A.R.).
- Fees: Appraisal fees are quoted individually based on the property, intended use, effective date, scope of work, and assignment complexity. Contact us for a personalized quote. A fee quote and availability are provided within 24 hours (one business day).
- Typical timeline: inspection within a few days of engagement; written report usually within 5–10 business days. Rush timelines are often available.
- Real estate brokerage services are offered separately through eXp Realty (DRE #01878277); appraisal work is independent of brokerage.

## Services

- [Estate & Trust Appraisal](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/estate-probate.html): Private, independent fair market value for California estates and trusts: date-of-death value, stepped-up basis, IRS Form 706 and estate tax documentation, trust administration, and equitable distribution and buyouts among heirs. In formal California probate, the court-appointed probate referee generally values real property for the inventory; HVG does not offer litigation or court services.
- [Date of Death Appraisal](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/date-of-death.html): Retrospective value as of the date of death, which can help document fair market value for basis determination, estate settlement, and, where a return is required, IRS Form 706. A CPA or tax attorney should confirm the applicable tax treatment.
- [Divorce Appraisal](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/divorce.html): Neutral, market-supported value for property settlement and mediation. Not litigation support.
- [Pre-Listing Appraisal](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/pre-listing.html): Independent value before listing a home for sale, to price correctly and avoid overpricing.
- [PMI Removal Appraisal](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/pmi-removal.html): Current market value to support a request to a mortgage servicer to remove private mortgage insurance. Servicers set eligibility and valuation requirements; some order the appraisal or other valuation directly.
- [For CPAs, Financial Advisors & Estate Attorneys](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/for-professionals.html): How referrals work and what reports include.

San Joaquin County: Tracy, Stockton, Manteca, Lathrop.
